title: Modal safety scope algebra keeps hypothetical hazards separate from voyage state
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. A shared ch/modal constructor composes pair arguments, absence conditions, counterfactual force, universal cargo scope and final harmlessness as propositions over a possible unattended world. It predicts a different complete-reading consequence from an actual-state safety guard: the written safety clauses describe what would be unsafe without the agent, but do not themselves veto a legal voyage.

observations: Frozen GDT993 SPEC has separate SAFETY, PAIR and CONCLUSION patterns; WOULD_BE and WITHOUT_AGENT are distinct atoms rather than movement commands.
RAW377 explicitly says qokchedy is a condition, chckhdy marks a general assertion, and the absent-agent clause is not an assertion that the agent is currently absent.
GDT993's surviving transport trace passes only under the stipulated conditional safety interpretation; its safety edges are not independently identified.
GDT608 and the prior component cards support formal order only, so the modal operators below remain a content hypothesis.

component_functions: ch seeds a typed proposition frame; it never creates a cargo or movement event.
qok applied inside a ch frame selects a transport-pair relation domain; its qokedy argument supplies CargoRef(G) rather than an action.
e opens the next proposition argument slot; dy closes a cargo reference in the bare ch frame as CargoRef(C), or closes the qok+ch relation as UNATTENDED(Pair).
ckh sets force=WOULD_BE; it scopes over the preceding pair property and does not mutate current transport state.
ched closes WITHOUT_AGENT(Agent); chety closes the UNHARMED property; checthy introduces ALL over the already named cargo set.
chedain remains a separate NEXT sequencing operator and is not absorbed into the modal frame.
evaluation_order: Construct the pair from the written CargoRef arguments before applying UNATTENDED.
Apply WITHOUT_AGENT to the typed Agent argument and form a possible-world condition.
Apply WOULD_BE to the resulting safety proposition; only then attach the unsafe predicate.
Evaluate voyage operations against actual bank state separately; a modal safety assertion may constrain a plan without asserting that its antecedent currently holds.
At the result, apply ALL and UNHARMED to the final co-location/attended state; do not feed them backward as movement commands.
mechanism.worked_consequence: The S11 chain `chedy ... qokchedy qokedy chckhdy sar` reduces to a proposition such as WOULD_BE(UNSAFE(Pair(C,G), WITHOUT_AGENT(M))), while S05/S09/S13 remain actual voyage transitions. Under this algebra, a legal trip may carry G while M is present even though the counterfactual pair is unsafe without M. The actual-state rival instead treats the same safety phrase as a live guard and may reject an otherwise legal trip. S18's checthy/chety-style conclusion quantifies the final cargo set and harmlessness after the last event; it does not retroactively alter the safety world.
mechanism.rival: An actual-state guard algebra evaluates UNATTENDED as a present fact at every voyage and blocks any pair that would be unsafe; a flat predicate algebra treats WOULD_BE, WITHOUT_AGENT and UNHARMED as unordered labels with no possible-world scope.

design.falsifier: Reject the modal model if a complete fixed passage uses the safety clause as an explicit present-state command, if WOULD_BE changes a voyage state without a written operation, if WITHOUT_AGENT lacks its written Agent argument, or if a later conclusion requires the safety proposition's antecedent to have held in the actual trace. A complete independently bound clause showing the same ch/modal state both as a hypothetical assertion and a live movement guard would also reject the fixed scope law.
design.strongest_failure: The modal distinction is already stipulated by the RAW377 reading and may merely restate English punctuation. No component meaning, possible-world operator, or independent agent binding is observed; the source packet cannot choose conditional safety from the manuscript. The model also leaves several che/ch forms dependent on hypothesized typed closures.

predecessors.limit: Conditional safety is an internally coherent reading, not independent semantic evidence.
Its qok/ch finite-state table omitted most frozen ch-family forms and conflated qokeedy with NEXT; this card instead tests modal scope.
Complete transport assignment with safety-frame reuse; no component-level modal algebra.
Residual event phases do not distinguish hypothetical predicates from actual state guards.

dependencies: The inherited cargo/agent names are opaque typed variables; no target word is independently translated.
The complete reading must preserve every safety, pair, conclusion and voyage group; no safety group may be dropped as filler.
Possible-world and actual-state scopes are fixed before any comparison; no analyst-selected reset or nearest-reference repair is allowed.
The model is exploratory and does not claim the target uses medieval transport logic.
design.access: GDT993 REPORT/SPEC/SOURCE_PACKET, RAW377 complete lexicon, bounded IDEA432 audit, and retained predecessor checks only; no target data/image, reserve, root experiment, decoder, route, ledger, or source mutation.
